products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere is a California-based enterprise software company founded in 2003. Its website describes it as the number one provider of agentic automation, and its platform combines artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, and what it calls agentic process automation to handle mission-critical business processes end to end. The company offers a Cloud Community Edition for free access to its full-featured automation tooling, and promotes a global partner network for deployment support.

The company's core product is its intelligent automation platform, which includes AI-powered bots, a control room for governance, and a credential vault for secure operations. Central to its current positioning is the Mozart Orchestrator, which the site describes as a tool for coordinating AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers within a single workflow. The platform is also marketed for IT service management use cases, including employee self-service, AIOps-driven incident prediction, and IT service desk cost reduction. The site cites a Gartner figure claiming that more than 90 percent of so-called agentic AI solutions are repackaged generative AI, and positions Automation Anywhere among a smaller group of vendors it says delivers genuine agent-driven orchestration.

The site's held facts indicate Automation Anywhere has a notable legal footprint, with 161 cases of California law exposure recorded in the reference database, though no specific litigation details are included in the available data. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings are noted for the company in the current held facts.
